system.description:
Usage worn gloves.

These cream-coloured gloves never retain bloodstains. Their palms bear a simple embroidered image of one hand supporting another.

You gain a +2-status bonus to Medicine checks.

You also gain the Steady Gift ability:

Steady Gift:

Activate Reaction

Trigger You cast a spell with the Healing trait that rolls one or more dice to restore HP

Frequency 1/day

After rolling the spell's healing dice, select one healing die and maximise it. If you are a Healer with the Lifebinder Calling, you may maximise two dice instead.

On the sheet: +2 status to Medicine while invested; Steady Gift is offered on your Healing spells (1/day): one healing die maximised — two with the Lifebinder Calling.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
